title: Explain a Study Plan

source.rights: 项目原创虚构教学材料；AI 编写并对照教学规则、原文和题目证据复核。
source.reviewScope: Ordinary A2 practice. Exact source contexts and answers reviewed; synthetic en-US audio checked for file integrity, decoding, role/segment alignment and unprompted ASR content. Pronunciation and intonation are not independently certified.

instructions: Write your own first draft and submit it for feedback.
prompt: Write 120–160 words to a friend about a course you would like to take. Explain your purpose, what you plan or decide to do, what you enjoy or want to avoid, and how you will complete an assignment. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: Organize four parts: course and reason; learning purpose and activities; a manageable study routine; assignment and help. Check to + base verb after plan and -ing after enjoy or avoid.
